<$cdef(27)> environment level, you’ll be able to buy
lots and lots of different items from the <$cdef(27)>shop!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! You got a sec?

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>At first, I was super excited when we started getting rain
around here, but you know what I realized?
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$facial(4,1)>If my tail gets wet in the rain, then...<$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,23)>I’m gonna catch a cold!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)>So I wanna see what it’s like living in a <$cdef(27)><$bfull(12)> like
you do, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>A roof would help keep me safe from the rain, and it’d
kinda feel like my own secret fort!
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)>Well, whaddya think? Can you build another <$cdef(27)><$bfull(12)>
for me?
<$voicel(4,9)><$motion(4,803)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,10)>I wanna see what it’s like living in a <$cdef(27)><$bfull(12)></color>!

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>But having a <$cdef(27)><$bfull(12)> to hide out in has been a huge
help, <$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,10)>so I wanted to say thanks! Here goes—THANKS!

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Yaaay! A <$cdef(27)><$bfull(12)>!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>I’m gonna live here from now on! Thanks a bunch for my
new home, <$cdef(27)>!

A Pokémon’s<$cdef(27)> comfort level will rise more easily if you
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> a house for them to live in!
If you want to become fast friends with a Pokémon, try
building a wonderful house and inviting them to move in!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Let’s hear what the <$cdef(27)>professor</color> has to say about celebrating!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh, hey! Nice job setting up that <$cdef(27)>furniture</color>.
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Ah, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>. Do you have a moment?

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)>Have you ever spotted flowers that seem to sparkle?
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,10)>If you see such a sparkle, do take a closer look. <$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,9)>You might
stumble upon some sweet <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3994)>!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>If you manage to bring me, say...<$cdef(27)> <$ifull(3994)>, <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,803)><$facial(4,4)>I’ll
give you a lovely little gift. How does that sound?

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,6)>There’s nothing I love more than <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3994)>. I simply
can’t get enough of it! <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)>Won’t you collect some for me?

<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,6)>I simply adore <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3994)>, you know!
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,803)><$facial(4,4)>If you would be so kind as to bring me <$cdef(27)> jars, I’ll be sure to
reward you with a lovely gift. ♪

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)>You should be able to gather <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3994)> from flowers that
have a touch of sparkle. ♪
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,803)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,9)>Ah, what a delightful smell! I know exactly what this is. ♪

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,6)>You’ve brought me some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3994)>, haven’t you?
Thank you, little <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,805)>Here’s your present, as promised. <$comeff(4,6)>Which one do you like?

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Going forward, if you bring me <$cdef(27)> <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3994)>,
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,8)>I’ll give you from my collection. ♪

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Hey there! Nice to meet ya! I’m just a humble li’l
<$cdef(27)>Magikarp, yo! <$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,817)>And I suddenly just found myself here
floppin’ and splashin’ about.
Can’t remember anything before that!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,14)>And you’re—wait! Don’t tell me! You’re
<$cdef(27)>,
right?!
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Yo, I’m so glad to get to meet you! I hope we can
be friends!

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>... Could I maybe get you
to
help
me
with
somethin’?
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$voicel(4,3)>I’m kinda missin’ the place I used to live. Yo, is this what
being homesick feels like?
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,815)><$voicel(4,7)><$voicel(4,7)>ANYWAY, basically...I’d be SUPER happy if you could
make me a home kinda like this!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>I’d LOVE for you to make me a home like the one I used to
live in, yo!
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,814)><$voicel(4,9)>I’ll teach you one of my best moves in return!

<$emotion(4,50)><$voicel(4,8)>Yooo! Thanks so much, <$cdef(27)>!
I’m totally grateful for the <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,8)>awesome home you made me!
<$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>All right, cool! Now I’ll teach you one of my best moves, as
promised! <$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,8)>You gotta watch closely while I do it, yo!

<$voicel(4,4)>*flop*
*flop*
*flop flop flop*

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Hi, <$cdef(27)>! Finished making
your home?
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,8)>That’s awesome! Congrats!

<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,6)>Didn’t humans usually celebrate when they got a
new house? <$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$facial(4,4)>We should too! Let’s party! Wooo!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Why, if it isn’t <$cdef(27)> and
<$cdef(27)>Charmander—quite
the
friendly
duo!
How
can
I
help you?

<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,48)>You know how <$cdef(27)> finished making
their
own house?
<$lookat(4,0,1)><$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,39)>We wanna do something to celebrate!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)><$lookat(1,0,4)>Hohoho! A celebration, you say? I think that’s a fine idea!
<$voicel(4,1)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,806)>But...how do we do that? Celebrate, I mean.

<$lookat(1,0,4)><$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,29)>What? Why, that’s simple. You just—uh... Hmmm.
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,13)>Now that I think about it, how DOES one
celebrate, exactly?
<$voicel(1,2)><$facial(1,14)>Hmmm... HMMMMMM...<$kfacial(1)>
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$motionoff(4,804)>No way... The <$cdef(27)>professor</color> doesn’t even know?

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,654)><$facial(1,9)>Urk! No...no, of course I do! <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,31)>Hmmm... How to celebrate...
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,10)>What would a human do in this situation...
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,40)>Aha! I’ve got it! <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,23)><$comeff(1,9)>If you want to have a celebration, you
need FOOD!
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,807)>Food? But we eat food, like, every day.

<$lookat(1,0,4)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)>No, no, that’s not what I’m talking about! You need LOTS
of food, and lots of different kinds too!
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,22)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>And when you eat it all together—THAT’s a celebration!

<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,27)>Got it! You really know everything, <$cdef(27)>Professor!
<$voicel(4,3)><$motion(4,634)><$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,655)>But do you think there’s enough different kinds of food
around here?

<$lookat(1,0,4)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)><$motion(4,635)><$comcan(4)>Hoho! I’ve got a wide variety of berries in my home!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,23)><$comeff(1,8)>There are even some very rare berries in there that I’ve
been saving for a special occasion! I daresay this qualifies,
so please, go ahead and take them!
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$emotion(1,9)>It’s quite the haul of berries to carry, but I’m sure you’re up
to the task, aren’t you, <$cdef(27)>?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,27)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,652)>Hold it! This is a celebration for <$cdef(27)>!
<$lookat(4,0,0)><$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>They should stay here—I’ll go grab the stuff!

<$lookat(1,0,4)><$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, I suppose you’re right.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,25)>In that case, you can use a cloth—you’ll find it on the floor
in my home.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>If you wrap the berries up in that cloth, you should be able
to carry them all!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,50)>Got it! OK, I’m off now. <$lookat(4,0,0)>Be back soon!
<$voicel(4,7)><$facial(1,1)>I’m baaack! And I brought berries! Get ready to celebrate!
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Now, now—no need to rush! Haste makes waste!
<$voicel(4,2)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,663)><$facial(1,9)>Wh-whoa!
*squish*
<$voicel(4,2)><$facial(4,10)><$kfacial(4)>I...I tripped.

<$kfacial(4)><$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>Goodness gracious—are you all right, <$cdef(27)>Charmander?
<$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,14)>...Hm?
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Do you smell something sweet?

<$voicel(4,1)><$facial(4,13)><$comeff(4,11)><$motion(4,803)>Oh NO! The berries! They all got squashed!
<$lookat(4,0,0)><$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$comeff(4,18)><$facial(4,9)>I’m sorry! So much for our big celebration...
<$kfacial(4)><$voicel(1,8)><$cdef(27)>Charmander</color>, could I see that cloth for a moment?
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)>THIS cloth? Sure, but it’s a big mess now...

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,645)>We’ll just do this over here, and a little of that...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)>And there we go!
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>Whoa, check it out! That shape looks like a <$cdef(27)>Ditto</color>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Say, <$cdef(27)>, why don’t you use that
flag
to
mark
your house?
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>We can call it a sort of...celebratory housewarming
present to you from <$cdef(27)>Charmander!
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,39)>Wait, so this means the celebration was a success?!
You got a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1440)></color>!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,22)><$kfacial(4)>Yes! This is a splendid celebration!
Go ahead and <$cdef(27)>put this flag on the house you built</color>!

Go ahead and <$cdef(27)>put the <$ifull(1440)> on top of the house
you <$spwicon(1)>built!
Congratulations! This is now officially your house!

From now on, each day of your life here will begin in
this house.
Place <$cdef(27)>furniture of your choosing to arrange your home
exactly how you want it.
You can even live together with your favorite Pokémon!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,644)>Oh, uh... I’m not really sure how you’re supposed to
celebrate stuff. Hmmm...
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)>But <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth might know—let’s go ask! <$voicel(4,10)><$motion(4,801)><$comeff(4,10)>C’mon,
let’s head over together!
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,803)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,10)>C’mon, let’s go ask the <$cdef(27)>professor</color> how to celebrate!

You can also select <$cdef(27)>Return Home on the <$keyicon(4)>main menu to
come back to this house anytime you like.
This can really come in handy if you ever get lost on your
adventures!

<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>That was a blast! It’s been a while since I got to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>
anything. Thanks, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)>But y’know what? A house isn’t ready to live in just ’cause
it’s all built!

<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)>You gotta put some <$cdef(27)>furniture in it!
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)>At least <$cdef(27)> pieces should do the trick. <$voicel(4,4)><$emotion(4,14)>And they can’t all
be the same, OK?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,8)>Humans were all about decorating their homes with cool
<$cdef(27)>furniture! <$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,805)><$facial(4,1)><$comeff(4,6)>Why don’t you try it, <$cdef(27)>?

There are several different ways to get <$cdef(27)>furniture.
You can pick up any you find on the ground or make some
at a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(764)>.
You can also get <$cdef(27)>furniture and <$cdef(27)>recipes at the<$cdef(27)> PC shop, so
look around and find your favorite <$cdef(27)>furniture!
If you ever end up with too much <$cdef(27)>furniture, you can always
store it in a nice, convenient <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2045)>!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,8)>Try putting some <$cdef(27)>furniture</color> in your house, like humans do!

<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,10)>At least <$cdef(27)> should do the trick. And they can’t all
be the same, OK?

There are several different ways to get <$cdef(27)>furniture.
You can pick up any you find on the ground or make some
at a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(764)>.
You can also get <$cdef(27)>furniture and <$cdef(27)>recipes at the<$cdef(27)> PC shop, so
look around and find your favorite <$cdef(27)>furniture!
If you ever end up with too much <$cdef(27)>furniture, you can always
store it in a nice, convenient <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2045)>!

Placing <$cdef(27)> of furniture really makes the place feel
more like home, doesn’t it?
Now you can live in this house!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,8)>There it is! That’s one of my best moves, yo! <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)>At the very
least, hoppin’ up on short ledges and things should be
no problem for you now!
I mean...<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,10)>it’s pretty much ONLY good for short ledges and
things, but it’s still pretty cool, right?
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Don’t go teachin’ any other Pokémon, OK?!
You learned how to <$cdef(27)>jump</color>! Press <$keyicon(3)> to hop around!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, I see your house was
completed!
No
accidents
along
the
way, either!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)>Compared to when I first met you, there are so many more
Pokémon here, <$voicel(1,8)>the plants are healthier...<$motion(1,652)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>The whole place feels like it’s returning to the way it
was before!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>And it’s made me remember something—something
amazing!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>It’s about this broken-down building here—just wait till you
hear what it was!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>It was a place where many humans and Pokémon used to
gather and interact. <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,20)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>In fact, I’m nearly certain this was a
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>What’s that? You’d already guessed that yourself?
I suppose I should have expected as much.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)>Well then, do you mind if I ask a little favor of
you, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)>If you recall, to make that house of yours, you used a
<$cdef(27)>building kit, yes?
<$voicel(1,5)>If you were able to get your hands on another <$cdef(27)>building kit
like that, but for a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Do you fancy you could build a new <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center
right here?

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>If we get a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center back up and running, this
place will feel even more like it did in the old days.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,801)>Why, it might even prompt the humans to return!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)>This time you’ll need even more materials and <$voicel(1,4)>Pokémon to
help you...<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>but based on what I know of you already, <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)>I’m
quite confident you can do this!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>We’re all counting on you, <$cdef(27)>!

You can get a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(326)> from the
<$cdef(27)>PC shop once you raise the <$cdef(27)>environment level enough.
Be sure to pay it a visit from time to time!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>The Pokémon here have been much livelier lately.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>That’s all thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>Now, if you manage to rebuild that <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center,
I’m sure things will become even more like they were
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>back when the humans were around!

At the current <$cdef(27)>environment level, you should be able to
buy a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(326)>!
Access the <$cdef(27)>shop and check it out!

<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,14)>Whenever you build a house, <$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,816)><$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)>try putting all sorts of
<$cdef(27)>furniture inside, like humans did!
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>I bet other Pokémon would really like it too!

<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,816)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,10)>Yay! All right, just leave the rest to us!
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,1)><$comeff(4,14)>It’ll take a while to finish <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing, <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,8)>so feel free to take
it easy and do your own thing while you wait.

<$cdef(27)>Charmander wants to celebrate with you! Bring them along
to talk to the <$cdef(27)>professor!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! You got a sec?

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>At first, I was happy when it started to rain more around
here, but you know what I realized?
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$facial(4,1)>If my tail gets wet in the rain, then...<$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,23)>I’m gonna catch a cold!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho! I see Pokémon have begun <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>I suspect it’ll take some time before it’s finished, so you
may as well put the downtime to good use.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,14)>For example... Why, you could help some Pokémon with
their requests!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Or you might even try making some habitats so more
Pokémon can join us!

When you’re out exploring, you may find sparkles on the
ground—those are <$cdef(27)>traces of a Pokémon!
If you touch them, you can get a hint about a habitat for a
Pokémon you haven’t yet befriended.

<$cdef(27)>Charmander wants to celebrate with you! Bring them along
to talk to the <$cdef(27)>professor!
